page_title: SHU 0-5 AST | Sheffield Utd v Aston Villa 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Paul Tierney is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Paul Tierney couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) and blew his whistle.
90+8' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90+4' Celebrations are cut short for Sheffield Utd as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+2' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Sheffield Utd players aren’t happy.
90+1' Goal! Jack Robinson gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:5.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Dangerous play by Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa). Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
90' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
81' Here comes a substitution. Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Youri Tielemans.

78' Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Emiliano Martinez anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.

78' A nice cross arrived in the box from the corner kick and found the head of Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd). He steered the ball towards the bottom left corner, but one of the defenders is there to cover the goalkeeper and keep it out.
77' Sheffield Utd win a corner.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sheffield Utd comes to nothing.
76' Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
72' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
72' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) replacing James McAtee.
71' Substitution. Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa) in, John McGinn out.
66' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) makes a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Substitution. Ben Brereton Diaz is replaced by Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd).
60' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Leon Bailey will be replaced by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa).
59' Substitution. Ezri Konsa makes way for Matty Cash (Aston Villa).
59' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
57' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Aston Villa, play can continue.
57' Referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Aston Villa. Let’s see what happens!
57' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Leon Bailey (Aston Villa), who plants a header just wide of the right post from close range.
55' Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) brings an opponent down and Paul Tierney interrupts the game. Aston Villa have a free kick from a promising distance.
54' Ball possession – 28:72.
52' Sheffield Utd concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
51' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
50' That will be all from Andre Brooks who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd).
50' Here is a change. Rhys Norrington-Davies is going off and Chris Wilder gives the last tactical orders to Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd).
50' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

47' 0 - 5 Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) meets a perfect cross from Ollie Watkins deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:5.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Douglas Luiz comes off for Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa).
46' Chris Wilder makes a switch. Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is coming on in place of William Osula at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Paul Tierney has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Flag goes up against Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+2' Paul Tierney blows his whistle. Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) commits a foul after dangerous play.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
41' John McGinn (Aston Villa) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
39' Paul Tierney blows for a foul after Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
36' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

35' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
33' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
30' 0 - 4 Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) meets a cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box and unleashes a precise shot, which bounces in off the crossbar.
30' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

30' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Wesley Foderingham sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net.
29' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
26' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.

26' What a chance that is! Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the left post.
25' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for an infringement.

20' 0 - 3 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
19' The linesman signals that Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

16' 0 - 2 Douglas Luiz sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:2.
15' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
12' 0 - 1 Goal! John McGinn (Aston Villa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.

10' Nice individual effort by Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom left corner, but Emiliano Martinez does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
6' John McGinn (Aston Villa) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes just over the crossbar!
5' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
3' Paul Tierney blows his whistle after Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
2' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Aston Villa will take the kick-off.
Paul Tierney is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
